meaning:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
(a) a mantle (Psa.102:27, Isa.59:17, al.) : Heb.1:12" (LXX)
(b) a veil: 1Co.11:15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
